purpose: Field registry for the Spatial Perturbation Analysis Layer 2 method-selection evidence package.

fields.name: Tool Name
fields.definition: Canonical method or tool identity in the frozen topic candidate set.
fields.fill_rule: Use the canonical method name from the frozen input JSON.
fields.topic_relevance: Defines the row identity.

fields.name: Method Family
fields.definition: Short algorithm-family label.
fields.fill_rule: Use a concise family phrase from the Layer 1 registry and verified method evidence.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes niche-aware generative response modeling from causal generative perturbation modeling.

fields.name: Main Input
fields.definition: High-level input picture for the method in this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use object-level input phrasing rather than parameter lists.
fields.topic_relevance: Clarifies whether the method expects explicit spatial perturbation-response data or a broader causal tissue-modeling input.

fields.name: Main Use in This Topic
fields.definition: Main role of the method inside Spatial Perturbation Analysis.
fields.fill_rule: Describe only the perturbation-response, causal, or counterfactual modeling role; do not foreground unrelated downstream claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps both frontier methods scoped to this analysis problem.

fields.name: Main Output
fields.definition: High-level output object relevant to this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use a short object-level phrase, not a package object or callable signature.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates response predictions from causal program and counterfactual tissue outputs.

fields.name: Closest Alternatives
fields.definition: Nearby alternatives from the same frozen topic set.
fields.fill_rule: Use local alternatives from the frozen candidate set. Prefer branch-near alternatives rather than a global ranking.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports local comparison without global ranking.

fields.name: Key Difference
fields.definition: Main decision difference versus nearby alternatives.
fields.fill_rule: Use one decision-level sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides branch-local selection logic.

fields.name: Compute Requirement
fields.definition: Coarse compute requirement only.
fields.fill_rule: Use the coarse label supported by the registry and method evidence; do not infer runtime readiness.
fields.topic_relevance: Acts as a branch-local resource gate.

fields.name: Memory Burden
fields.definition: Coarse memory burden.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Prefer unclear when direct public support is weak.
fields.topic_relevance: Captures practical constraints without creating execution claims.

fields.name: Scale Sensitivity
fields.definition: Coarse sensitivity to larger spatial scale, multi-sample scale, or high-resolution tissue datasets.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Be conservative unless public evidence directly supports a label.
fields.topic_relevance: Helps decide whether large perturbation atlases or multi-slice settings need later engineering scrutiny.

fields.name: Code Access
fields.definition: Current code-access state.
fields.fill_rule: Record access state only; do not equate access with runtime support.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports later audit triage.

fields.name: Primary Code Link
fields.definition: One primary code or official documentation location.
fields.fill_rule: Fill only when an official or clearly primary code/documentation source is confirmed.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides a traceable code source for later engineering review.

fields.name: Evidence Source
fields.definition: Main evidence basis for the row.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled source label.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes direct method evidence from review or community-use evidence.

fields.name: Evidence Note
fields.definition: Short note on what is direct evidence and what is Layer 2 synthesis.
fields.fill_rule: Use one to three concise sentences. Mark comparison, burden, risk, and first-choice fields as synthesized when appropriate.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps uncertainty and evidence strength visible.

fields.name: Best First Choice When
fields.definition: Best-fit starting condition within this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use one positive conditional sentence. Do not write default-method claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Feeds the decision tree.

fields.name: Do Not Start With This When
fields.definition: Main condition where this method should not be the first method read or trialed.
fields.fill_rule: Use one concise exclusion sentence.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents method misuse without claiming runtime failure.

fields.name: Perturbation Question Type
fields.definition: Primary scientific question type addressed by the method.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value. Separate predictive response modeling, causal counterfactual modeling, observed perturbation-effect detection, perturbation-responsive pattern prioritization, and spatiotemporal regulator prioritization.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates predictive response modeling from causal counterfactual tissue modeling.

fields.name: Spatial Mechanism Emphasis
fields.definition: Dominant way the method represents spatial perturbation context.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value that reflects the direct method description.
fields.topic_relevance: Highlights whether local niche effects or causal cell-cell program structure should drive first reading.

fields.name: Direct Perturbation Data Cue
fields.definition: Coarse cue about the perturbation evidence or data condition emphasized by the method evidence.
fields.fill_rule: Use measured perturbation-response ST only when the method is framed around measured perturbation transcriptomics. Use condition-labeled spatial omics for observed treatment, exposure, disease, or perturbation condition comparisons. Use unclear when the requirement cannot be verified from bounded evidence.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents overextending a method to data conditions not supported by the bounded evidence pass.

fields.name: Validation Evidence Scope
fields.definition: Coarse public validation scope visible from the bounded method-paper evidence.
fields.fill_rule: Use one controlled value; do not convert method-paper comparisons into independent benchmarks.
controlled_values: method-paper simulations plus tissue case studies
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps validation strength and benchmark limitations visible.

fields.name: Scientific Caveat
fields.definition: Concise caveat about causal assumptions, counterfactual validation, frontier evidence, or benchmark limitations.
fields.fill_rule: Use conservative free text. Do not convert the caveat into a severity score unless later evidence justifies that.
fields.topic_relevance: Makes scientific-critical-thinking concerns explicit in method selection.
